item.title: Announcements: ESIL 2027 Annual Conference; RCSL panel call
item.content:encoded:
ESIL 2027 Annual Conference. The European Society of International Law will meet in Leiden, 9–11 September 2027. Abstracts are due 15 January 2027 (23:59 CET). Keynote: Jane Doe.

RCSL panel at LSA 2027. The working group on computational law invites papers for a panel at the LSA 2027 Annual Meeting. Send abstracts by 1 December 2026.
